# Tech Valley Filtration

> Tech Valley Filtration, LLC is a commercial HVAC air filtration distributor and service provider based in Albany, NY (30 Kraft Ave, Suite 5, Albany, NY 12205), serving commercial, institutional, and industrial facilities across the Northeast since 2019. Phone: (800) 344-6214. Email: Service@techvalleyfiltration.com.

Tech Valley Filtration supplies MERV-rated, HEPA, carbon, and specialty air filters, UV-C disinfection systems, and HVAC drive components, and specifies filtration to NAFA best practice and ASHRAE standards. Same-day will-call pickup is available from the Albany warehouse.

## Services

- [Bag-In/Bag-Out (BIBO) HEPA Filter Changeouts](https://techvalleyfiltration.com/products.html#bibo): On-site BIBO HEPA filter changeout service. Tech Valley Filtration supplies replacement HEPA and pre-filters matched to the BIBO housing (plus bags and bands), performs the sealed changeout so the spent filter stays contained in a bag from the moment it leaves the housing, removes sealed spent filters for disposal in line with the site's waste-handling requirements, and provides written changeout documentation for compliance files. Common applications: hospitals and isolation rooms, labs and biosafety, pharma and biotech, indoor firing ranges, hazardous dust and industrial exhaust, cleanrooms, and data centers.
- [Technical consultation and system analysis](https://techvalleyfiltration.com/products.html): Filter selection by application, MERV ratings, HEPA configurations, and ASHRAE 62.1 compliance.
- [Custom-sized filters](https://techvalleyfiltration.com/products.html): Non-standard sizes built to exact dimensions.
- [Request a quote or order](https://techvalleyfiltration.com/quote.html)

## Products

- [Product catalog](https://techvalleyfiltration.com/products.html): Pleated filters, pocket filters, carbon filters, rigid box / mini-pleat / V-bank filters, HEPA filters, link and panel filters, metal washable filters, cartridge filters, V-belts and power transmission, UV-C disinfection systems, and washable filter screens.

## Industries

- [Industries served](https://techvalleyfiltration.com/industries.html): Higher education, K-12 schools, healthcare and senior living, government and commercial, libraries and museums, manufacturing, indoor firing ranges, infection control, cannabis cultivation, and computer data centers.
